name: markdown-check
title: Markdown Check
description: Markdown field that catches unclosed ** or backticks, [text] (url) with a space, empty or space-broken links, #Title with no space and raw HTML the sanitizer strips, previews each spot as it will render, and offers a one-tap fix.

meta.summary: Catches Markdown that will render differently from how it reads, like an unclosed ** or a link broken by a space, and previews each spot.
catches: [text] (url) with a space, and empty or space-broken links
Raw HTML tags your sanitizer strips (allowedTags)
limits: Follows CommonMark/GitHub-style rules; other renderers differ
Not a full Markdown parser, so nested edge cases can be missed
Default allowed tags mirror GitHub-style sanitizers; pass yours
a11y: Visible label; textarea is described by a polite status region
Problems wait for a pause while typing and show at once on blur
Each issue has a select button and a fix button
